sizing_workshop_summary: Workshop held 2026-02-18 (90m) — Jordan + Priya + Aurora infra + CTO
Baseline assumptions agreed: 500 steady QPS (chat/risk), peak bursts to 5k QPS for short windows (3-8 mins)
Token profile: average request = 120 input tokens, 40 generated tokens => ~160 token/req
Baseline throughput target: ~80k tokens/sec steady; peak token/sec target: ~800k tokens/sec during bursts
Latency SLO: p95 <= 150ms for chat generation, p99 <= 350ms acceptable for heavy scoring calls

GPU sizing recommendation (initial): reserved pool = 8x A100-equivalent GPUs (dedicated) for steady + autoscale burst to 32 GPUs for peak; consider mixed-precision quantized model variants to reduce GPU footprint
Fallbacks & routing: prefer local dedicated model variant for primary traffic, automated fallback to hosted lower-cost variant for non-critical workloads during capacity saturation
KV caching: recommended prefix caching for repeated session prefixes (expected 25% token reduction in steady state)
Batching strategy: continuous batching with 5-20ms aggregation window; target effective batch size 64-128 for scoring model
Capacity plan to include warm standby (2 GPUs) for immediate failover + burst buffer of 8 GPUs for predictables spikes
Next step: Redwood to produce sizing workbook (v1) + cost estimate and draft SLA with latency SLOs and credits
